Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and notes on next steps. Happy to cover more on the call 11/6.

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (report period: Jan–Dec 2024). We provide a redacted report and an online portal for full report access after an NDA. Links: https://redwoodinference.app/soc2-portal/FTC-2025 (portal access requires a short form).

2) HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment and Dedicated offerings. We do offer a BAA for covered customers — legal will coordinate the standard BAA template if you want to proceed.

3) Telemetry: By default, telemetry (metrics, anonymized traces, aggregated logs) is stored in our US regions (customers may pin to a region for Private deployments). Retention: default 90 days for aggregated metrics, 30 days for traces, 365 days for audit logs (configurable for Dedicated/Private). PII: we have automatic PII filters on common fields (SSNs, emails in free text are redacted by default) and advise customers to use prefix/KV caching and filtering to avoid sensitive tokens in prompts. We can provide a telemetry dataflow diagram on the call.

4) Cookies & docs: Console sets a minimal session cookie for auth and a consent-driven analytics cookie (Google Analytics, anonymized IPs) on docs.redwoodinference.com. Customers can disable analytics cookies via account settings in Dedicated/Private or add a CSP/opt-out header in Private deployments. For hosted customers we provide an opt-out guidance document (attached).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Redwood_Data_Privacy_and_Telemetry_FAQ.pdf, Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Next steps: 
- Please complete the attached questionnaire and return by EOD Mon 11/10 if possible.
- We will schedule the 11/6 compliance Q&A (Marissa, can you send invite).

Regards,
Aditya Rao
